messages:
Avery: quick PR to add a tiny 'onprem checklist' for private installs: port matrix row, minimal nftables+iptables examples, offline cert sync script, and an IPv6 toggle. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4699
Jo: will review. please include PKCS#11 port (5696) and note UDP 123 for NTP. For airgapped sites emphasise checksum for cert bundle.
Kai: security nit: recommend chmod 660 on pkcs11 sockets and disable core dumps for the redwood user. Also add a short backoff note for PKCS#11 retries on startup.
Avery: draft offline sync (will add systemd timer in PR):
```
#!/bin/sh
set -e
scp -o BatchMode=yes ops@jump:/tmp/redwood-certs.tgz /tmp/
mkdir -p /etc/redwood/certs
tar -xzf /tmp/redwood-certs.tgz -C /etc/redwood/certs
chown -R redwood:redwood /etc/redwood/certs
rm -f /tmp/redwood-certs.tgz
```
Jo: add small conntrack/sysctl example for high-throughput sites: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=250000`
BuildBot: docs-ci: preview built for PR #4699 — https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference.internal/4699/
Avery: thanks — I'll push the TOC anchors and the anchor fix (install-checklist -> networking-check) before merging. review pls.
